pattern: ながらに / ながらの
purpose: Preserve an original state or describe an action in that state.
keywords: N / Vます stem + ながらに; N + ながらの
We can see images from around the world without leaving home.
She explained the situation through tears.
formation: N / Vます stem + ながらに; N + ながらの
restrictions: Common with 生まれ, 昔, 居, and 涙.
mistake: This entry concerns an unchanged state, rather than doing two tasks.
